prompt_text: I need braces or Invisalign in Houston. Which specific orthodontists should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Houston for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — I’ll find specific orthodontists near you and explain why to call them — but first I need one piece of information:

1) What ZIP code or neighborhood in Houston are you nearest to? (Houston’s big — I’ll pick different doctors if you’re near the Galleria vs. Katy vs. Pearland.)  
2) Is this for an adult or a child/teen?  
3) Do you definitely want Invisalign, or are you open to traditional metal/ceramic braces as well?

If you prefer, I can give general advice and a ready-to-use short list of questions to call any office now. Below is a checklist and how I’ll choose recommendations once you give me your location.

How I’ll pick specific orthodontists for you
- Invisalign experience level: look for Diamond/Platinum Elite Invisalign providers (lots of cases treated). These have more experience with complex Invisalign cases. I’ll verify via Align’s doctor locator and office websites.  
- Board certification & AAO membership: American Association of Orthodontists membership and board certification (if available) indicate specialized training.  
- Digital workflow & tech: iTero or other intraoral scanners, 3D treatment planning, and clear communication of expected tooth movement. These speed up diagnosis and let you see predicted results.  
- Before/after galleries and case types: I’ll prefer doctors who show adult/teen Invisalign case examples similar to your needs.  
- Location, office hours, financing/insurance acceptance, and availability for consultations.  
- Patient reviews and Google/Yelp ratings for patient experience, chairside manner, appointments and follow-up care.

Questions to ask when you call (use this script)
- “How many Invisalign cases do you treat per year?” (More cases = more experience.)  
- “Are you an Invisalign Gold/Platinum/Diamond provider?” (If Invisalign is your priority.)  
- “Do you use a digital scanner (iTero) and do you show a ClinCheck/3D plan before treatment?”  
- “What are the estimated total cost and monthly payment options? Do you accept my insurance?”  
- “How many in-office visits will I need and how long are they?”  
- “Do you use attachments/elastics often, and do you charge extra for refinements/retainers?”  
- “What’s your policy for emergency care or broken aligners/brackets?”  
- “Can I see before/after photos of patients with a problem similar to mine?”  

Typical timeline & cost (ballpark)
- Invisalign: $3,500–$7,500 (simple to complex cases).  
- Metal braces: $3,000–$6,000.  
- Treatment length: 6–24 months depending on complexity.  
- Ask for a written treatment estimate and what’s included (refinements, retainers).

How I can help next
- If you tell me your ZIP code and whether this is for an adult or child, I’ll return a short list (4–6) of specific Houston orthodontists/clinics to call, with: office name, neighborhood, phone, why each is recommended (Invisalign experience level, tech, specialties), and a suggested first-call script customized for each office.

Which would you prefer — give me your ZIP and I’ll pull a targeted list, or would you like a ready-to-call general list of top tips and what to look for?
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
